summary: ArcelorMittal filed a Form 6-K attaching an underwriting agreement for a $1 billion public debt offering of 5.375% notes due 2036. The company is issuing the notes at 98.712% of principal through a syndicate led by J.P. Morgan. This is a routine capital markets transaction with no special-situation element—no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, or other event-driven corporate action. The filing merely reports the debt issuance under Rule 13a-16. There are no deal terms beyond the fixed coupon and issue price; the notes will be settled on May 19, 2026. The SEC reporting is standard for a foreign private issuer conducting a public debt offering.
